description: Stable client-facing contract for Alicia mobile RAG integration. Mobile consumes plans and executes only local allowlisted handlers.
clientResponsibilities: Never execute an action unless it matches a local action handler allowlist.
Require visible user confirmation for all mutating actions.
Use the current app login Authorization when calling RAG and CloudStorageApi.
Reject absolute URLs, unknown methods, unknown action types, and stale candidate bindings.
Treat RAG output as a plan, not as proof that an operation has completed.
Refresh file and trash views only after the local executor reports a completed mutating action.

localModules.name: RagAssistantClient
localModules.responsibility: Call /api/assistant/plan and decode the stable response fields.

localModules.name: RagConversationStore
localModules.responsibility: Persist conversationId, pending candidates, and pending review state in ViewModel state.

localModules.name: RagActionBridgeValidator
localModules.responsibility: Validate backendActionDraft against the local action bridge allowlist before any API call.

localModules.name: RagActionExecutor
localModules.responsibility: Own the disabled-by-default execution boundary; dispatch validated and confirmed drafts to existing AliciaRepository methods only after app UI deliberately enables submission, then emit completed mutation signals for local refresh.

localModules.name: RagReviewPresenter
localModules.responsibility: Build read-only plan, candidate selection, client upload, and final confirmation presentation models for mobile UI.

none.notes: Persona, product Q&A, out-of-scope, and fallback replies.

search.notes: RAG performs read-only binding through CloudStorageApi; mobile shows candidateBinding or actionPlan bindings.

rename.notes: phoneAppAdd has RenameNodePayload, Retrofit renameNode, Repository renameNode, candidate selection click-through, basic confirm/cancel review controls, and a disabled-by-default RagActionExecutor route; real execution still requires an explicit app submission switch.

delete.notes: Always move to trash in phase 1; permanent delete stays disabled.

share.notes: Share options may be adjusted by review UI before submit.

upload_target.notes: RAG only resolves the target folder. Mobile displays a client upload action, collects local file URI through the system picker, and calls the existing uploadFile flow with the bound parentId; backendActionDraft is not submitted by RagActionExecutor.

composite.create_folder_then_upload.notes: Mobile displays a create-then-upload client action. After the user selects local files, MainViewModel creates the folder under the bound parentId and uploads selected files into the created folder through the existing upload flow.

collection.trash_by_name_contains.notes: Mobile shows exact count, filter summary, preview rows, and incomplete-preview blocking text before any submit; RagActionExecutor remains disabled by default.

collection.trash_by_category.notes: Mobile shows exact count, filter summary, preview rows, and incomplete-preview blocking text before any submit; RagActionExecutor remains disabled by default.

collection.move_by_extension.notes: Mobile shows exact source count, filter summary, preview rows, and resolved target folder before any submit; RagActionExecutor remains disabled by default.

collection.move_by_name_contains.notes: Mobile shows exact source count, filter summary, preview rows, and resolved target folder before any submit; RagActionExecutor remains disabled by default.

collection.rename_add_prefix.notes: Recognized for future expansion, but action bridge intentionally does not expose execution yet.

preMobileIntegrationGates: Debug web validates all automated acceptance scenarios.
Action bridge paths match CloudStorageApi and mobile allowlist.

RagActionExecutor stays disabled by default through ALICIA_RAG_ACTION_EXECUTION_ENABLED=false until mobile review UI validates the draft, shows final confirmation, and explicitly enables app UI submission.
RAG service base URL and Authorization forwarding are configurable per environment.
DeepSeek API key is supplied through environment variables and not committed.
Destructive actions show candidate path, count, and final confirmation.
